report.summary: Payments timed out starting at 2026-10-17T13:06:00Z due to a cascade of statement timeouts in ledger-service caused by database connection pool saturation and write lock contention in ledger-db.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Database connection pool saturation and statement timeouts in ledger-db

supporting.note: Shows payments-api error rate spiking at 13:06:00Z.
Shows active connections on ledger-db surging from ~45 to ~180 starting at 13:05:00Z.
Shows ledger-db latency spiking starting at 13:05:00Z.
Shows ledger-service hitting statement timeouts on INSERT INTO ledger_entries starting at 13:06:04Z.
Shows payments-api timing out waiting on ledger-service POST /entries starting at 13:06:02Z.

contradicting.note: ledger-db CPU dropped rather than increased during the incident, pointing to connection waiting/blocking rather than heavy query compute.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Config change on payments-api ledger client logging introduced performance degradation

supporting.note: A config change modified ledger client logging from INFO to DEBUG at 13:02:00Z, shortly before the incident onset.

contradicting.note: Errors originate in ledger-db and ledger-service statement timeouts on database inserts, not in client logging routines.

facts.text: Payments-api error rate and p99 latency anomalies started at 2026-10-17T13:06:00Z.
Ledger-service error rate and latency anomalies started at 2026-10-17T13:05:00Z / 13:06:00Z.
Ledger-db active connections jumped from ~45 to ~180 at 2026-10-17T13:05:00Z.
Ledger-service logged statement timeouts on INSERT INTO ledger_entries starting at 2026-10-17T13:06:04Z.
Payments-api logged timeouts waiting for ledger-service POST /entries starting at 2026-10-17T13:06:02Z.
Config change chg-9660 updated payments-api ledger client log level to DEBUG at 2026-10-17T13:02:00Z.

assumptions: The surge in active database connections reaching ~180 corresponds to maximum connection pool capacity, causing subsequent queries to queue and hit statement timeouts.
The drop in ledger-db CPU usage is due to threads waiting on locks or connection acquisition.
evidence_gaps: Exact connection pool maximum limit configuration for ledger-service was not inspected directly.
Detailed query execution plans and row lock contention telemetry were not available.

timeline.event: Config change chg-9660 applied to payments-api changing ledger client log level to DEBUG
ledger-db active connections spike to 180 and p99 latency jumps
Error rate and latency anomalies register on payments-api and ledger-service
First payments-api timeout error logged for ledger-service POST /entries
First ledger-service statement timeout logged for INSERT INTO ledger_entries

recommended_actions.action: Kill or cancel stuck or long-running transactions on ledger-db holding locks.
recommended_actions.rationale: Active connections are saturated and queries are hitting 10s statement timeouts due to lock contention.

recommended_actions.action: Scale up database connection limits or restart connection pools on ledger-service.
recommended_actions.rationale: Exhausted connection pools prevent new write requests from being processed.

recommended_actions.action: Investigate database query execution plans for INSERT INTO ledger_entries to identify locking bottlenecks.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents recurrence of database write deadlocks and connection saturation.

recommended_actions.action: Implement circuit breakers and bulkhead isolation between payments-api and ledger-service.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents downstream database saturation from completely blocking payment front-ends.

recommended_actions.action: Add automated alerting for database active connection pool saturation exceeding 80% capacity.
recommended_actions.rationale: Early warning before connection exhaustion leads to user-facing timeouts.
